title: Logo overview

location.series: Jessie W. Lee / Verizon Master Brand Redesign

slide_intent: Choose the appropriate signature for the surrounding context so recognition does not depend on an unexplained symbol.
strategic_value: The complete wordmark can establish Verizon’s identity while the checkmark can serve familiar Verizon environments.
demonstration: The July 22, 2021 overview separates the primary wordmark-and-checkmark lockup from a standalone red checkmark and links to name and logo policies.
practical_value: Prioritize the full signature and reserve the standalone checkmark for contexts already identified as Verizon.
